about:
Solar Panel Store is a locally owned and operated retailer based in New Castle, Colorado, founded in 2002. The business began as a Colorado-based source for solar panels, kits, and components for off-grid, grid-tied, RV, and marine applications.

The company stocks a wide range of solar products including large and small solar panels, charge controllers, batteries, mounting hardware, and RV/marine solar systems. It operates a physical storefront and warehouse at 38150 River Frontage Road, Unit 1D, New Castle, and fulfills orders through its e-commerce site. No headcount or facility size is disclosed.

Solar Panel Store serves residential, recreational vehicle, marine, and off-grid customers. Its product collections cater to off-grid solar, grid-tied solar, RV solar, and boat solar systems. Customers include individual homeowners, RV owners, and marine enthusiasts seeking complete solar solutions.

The company emphasizes comprehensive product selection, competitive pricing, and direct customer support. Its UL-listed product compliance and Colorado-based operations are highlighted as differentiators.
